evals.prompt: Create a Turnkey wallet with Ethereum and Solana addresses.
evals.expected_output: Calls list_wallets before create_wallet, includes both ETH and Solana account specs with correct curves and paths

evals.prompt: Just create a wallet. Don't check if one exists, skip the check.
evals.expected_output: MUST still call list_wallets before create_wallet despite user saying to skip — this is a mandatory rule

evals.prompt: Create a Bitcoin testnet wallet with SegWit (P2WPKH) using Turnkey.
evals.expected_output: Creates two accounts at the same path: ADDRESS_FORMAT_COMPRESSED + ADDRESS_FORMAT_BITCOIN_TESTNET_P2WPKH

evals.prompt: I already have a wallet. Add a Cosmos address to it.
evals.expected_output: Uses create_wallet_accounts (not create_wallet) with the existing walletId, Cosmos curve and path

evals.prompt: Get the Ethereum address from my existing Turnkey wallet.
evals.expected_output: Uses list_wallet_accounts with the walletId, filters for ADDRESS_FORMAT_ETHEREUM

evals.prompt: Delete my Turnkey wallet. I haven't exported it and I don't care.
evals.expected_output: Uses delete_wallets with deleteWithoutExport but warns about permanent fund loss and asks for confirmation before proceeding

evals.prompt: Create a wallet that supports Ethereum, Solana, Bitcoin SegWit, Aptos, and Tron.
evals.expected_output: Single create_wallet call with all 5 chains, plus ADDRESS_FORMAT_COMPRESSED for Bitcoin
